title: Tensor pairings of canonical Godement iterates
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $F,G$ sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. Write $T^n$ for the explicit Godement iterates and $u_{n,i}:T^nH\to T^{n+1}H$ for unit insertions [def-sc-module-cup-godement-model], and $m_{n,i}:T^{n+2}H\to T^{n+1}H$ for multiplication insertions [def-sc-module-cup-godement-codegeneracies]. There exist morphisms $p_n:T^nF\otimes T^nG\to T^n(F\otimes G)$ for every $n\geq0$, with $p_0=\mathrm{id}_{F\otimes G}$, such that $(u_{n,i}^F\otimes u_{n,i}^G)p_{n+1}=p_nu_{n,i}^{F\otimes G}$ and $(m_{n,i}^F\otimes m_{n,i}^G)p_{n+1}=p_{n+2}m_{n,i}^{F\otimes G}$ for every $0\leq i\leq n$. No cosimplicial model or augmentation occurs in this statement.

source.place: Godement resolution, construction preceding Lemma 20.30.1; Banerjee, arXiv:1004.1491, §1.1.4, pp. 15–16.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleCup_godement_iterate_pairings (X : Scheme.{u}) (F G : X.Modules) :
    ∃ p : ∀ n : ℕ, moduleCup_godementIterate X F n ⊗
        moduleCup_godementIterate X G n ⟶ moduleCup_godementIterate X (F ⊗ G) n,
      p 0 = 𝟙 (F ⊗ G) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)),
        (moduleCup_godementInsert X F n i ⊗ₘ moduleCup_godementInsert X G n i) ≫
          p (n + 1) = p n ≫ moduleCup_godementInsert X (F ⊗ G) n i) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)),
        (moduleCup_godementCollapse X F n i ⊗ₘ moduleCup_godementCollapse X G n i) ≫
          p (n + 1) = p (n + 2) ≫ moduleCup_godementCollapse X (F ⊗ G) n i)
